items.source: Calls the detectHandlers() method in addition to the superclass's initialization.
items.translation: 调用父类的初始化方法，并额外调用detectHandlers() 方法。

items.source: The actual URL determination for a handler is up to the concrete determineUrlsForHandler(String) implementation. A bean for which no such URLs could be determined is simply not considered a handler.
items.translation: 处理程序的实际 URL 确定由具体的 determineUrlsForHandler(String) 实现决定。如果无法为某个 Bean 确定此类 URL，则该 Bean 将不被视为处理程序。

items.source:
Default is "false": Only handler beans in the current ApplicationContext
will be detected, i.e. only in the context that this HandlerMapping itself
is defined in (typically the current DispatcherServlet's context).
items.translation: 默认为"false"：仅检测当前 ApplicationContext 中的处理器 Bean，即仅在定义此 HandlerMapping 的上下文中（通常是当前 DispatcherServlet 的上下文）进行检测。

items.source: Determine the URLs for the given handler bean.
items.translation: 确定给定处理器 Bean 的 URL。

items.source: ApplicationContextException - in case of initialization errors
items.translation: ApplicationContextException - 在初始化错误的情况下

items.source: the URLs determined for the bean, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 为 Bean 确定的 URL，如果没有则为空数组。

items.source:
Switch this flag on to detect handler beans in ancestor contexts
(typically the Spring root WebApplicationContext) as well.
items.translation: 打开此标志以在祖先上下文（通常是 Spring 根 WebApplicationContext）中检测处理器 Bean。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the HandlerMapping interface, detecting URL mappings for handler beans through introspection of all defined beans in the application context.
items.translation: `HandlerMapping` 接口的抽象实现，通过检查应用上下文中定义的所有 bean 来检测处理器的 URL 映射。

items.source: Register all handlers found in the current ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 注册当前 ApplicationContext 中发现的所有处理器。

items.source: Set whether to detect handler beans in ancestor ApplicationContexts.
items.translation: 设置是否在祖先 ApplicationContext 中检测处理器 Bean。

items.source: BeansException - if the handler couldn't be registered
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法注册处理器

items.source: beanName - the name of the candidate bean
